No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. The fish descends into a lovecraftian monologue about "horrors beyond it's comprehension" and has an existensial crisisassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

The sun beats down on the sandy shore as a human, JEN (30s), wades into the ocean, her eyes scanning the water for signs of life. Suddenly, she spots a fish, FINLEY (a sleek, silver fish), swimming near the surface. She reaches out a hand, and Finley is sucked into her grasp.

JEN
(excitedly)
Oh, look at you! You're so beautiful!

Finley struggles and squirms in Jen's hand, but she holds tight. Jen pulls Finley out of the water and onto the beach, where Finley lies flailing on the sand.

JEN
(curiously)
What's wrong, little guy? You're not used to being out of the water, are you?

Finley looks up at Jen with a mixture of fear and confusion. Jen holds him up to the sky, and Finley's gaze follows the sun as it begins to darken.

JEN
(amused)
Oh, look! A solar eclipse! Isn't it amazing?

Finley's eyes widen in terror as the sun's corona appears, casting an otherworldly glow over the beach. Finley's body begins to contort and twist, his scales shimmering with an eerie light.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
The void... it's coming... the void is coming...

Jen looks on in confusion as Finley's monologue grows more frantic.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(urgently)
I see things... horrors beyond my comprehension... twisted, eldritch creatures lurking in the depths... the stars are screaming... the universe is unraveling...

Finley's body begins to writhe and contort, his fins flailing wildly as he speaks.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(desperately)
What is the meaning of existence? Is it to swim in the ocean, to feed, to reproduce? Or is it something more? Something that defies the laws of nature? Something that...

Finley's voice trails off as the sun's corona grows larger, casting an eerie, pulsing glow over the beach.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I am but a small, insignificant speck in an infinite expanse... a fleeting moment in the grand tapestry of time... and yet... and yet...

Finley's body goes limp, his eyes fixed on the sun as it disappears behind the moon.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I am but a fish... a mere mortal... and yet... I am not...

Jen looks on, bewildered, as Finley's monologue fades into silence. She holds him up to the sky, where the sun's corona still lingers, casting an otherworldly glow over the beach.

JEN
(softly)
It's okay, little guy. You're safe now.

Finley's eyes flicker open, and he gazes up at Jen with a mixture of fear and confusion.

FINLEY
(whispering)
I am not safe... I am not safe...

Finley's body begins to contort and twist once more, his scales shimmering with an eerie light.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - LATER

Jen holds Finley in her hand, his body still and quiet. She looks out at the ocean, where the sun is rising once more.

JEN
(softly)
I think I'll let you go, little guy. You can swim back to the ocean.

Finley's eyes flicker open, and he gazes up at Jen with a mixture of fear and confusion.

FINLEY
(whispering)
No... I will not go back... I will not be silenced...

Finley's body begins to contort and twist once more, his scales shimmering with an eerie light.

JEN
(alarmed)
Finley! What's wrong?

Finley's voice grows louder, more urgent.

FINLEY
(whispering)
The void... it's coming... the void is coming...

Jen looks on in horror as Finley's body begins to dissolve into a cloud of shimmering, iridescent scales.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - LATER

Jen stands alone on the beach, staring out at the ocean. The sun is setting, casting a golden glow over the waves.

JEN
(whispering)
I think I'll never forget you, Finley.

The camera lingers on Jen's face, her eyes fixed on the horizon.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
